messages:
Lina: quick sync - proposing 'packing slices' as a small refactor to continuous batching. slices = immutable packing units that own kv pins. pros: simpler cache pins, easier accounting. cons: potential HOL latency for tiny slices. thoughts?
Arjun: seems neat. how do we prevent tiny-request HOL? hedging/fastpath?
Lina: yes, fastpath: single-tenant slices under threshold go straight to fast lane. mixed slices are allowed but gated by max_mixed_ratio.
Maya: telemetry is critical: slice.id, slice.pack_density, slice.kv_misses, slice.latency_p95, slice.tenant_mix. otherwise we won't know warmup cost.
Diego: eviction: either split slice on eviction (complex) or conservative reject-on-mix. suggest start with reject-on-mix and opt-in split later.
Arjun: autoscaler note: packed slices increase token throughput; add metric tag packed=true so scaling rules don't overreact.
ci-bot: build/packing-slices started - https://ci.redwood.example/packing-slices/4965000000
Lina: owners: Maya runtime + metrics, Arjun admission/score, Diego rollout plan. I'll write RFC draft and demo next Tue.
Maya: add proactive warming for slices with many cold keys as experiment. could reduce p95 spike.
Diego: agree but keep warmers low-priority to limit cost.
Lina: cool. will open PR behind feature flag and a small e2e. thanks all :thumbsup:
